import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-exams-admin', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

📋 Exams

{{editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add New'}} Exam

TitleSubjectDateTimeDurationStatusScoreActions
{{e.title}}{{e.subject}}{{e.date}}{{e.time}}{{e.duration}} {{e.status}} {{e.score || '-'}}
` }) export class ExamsAdminComponent { showForm = false; editingId: number | null = null; formData = { title: '', subject: '', date: '', time: '', duration: '', status: 'Upcoming', score: null as number | null }; exams: any[] = [ { id: 1, title: 'Java Mid-Term', subject: 'Java Programming', date: '20 Jan 2026', time: '10:00 AM', duration: '2 hours', status: 'Upcoming', score: null }, { id: 2, title: 'Data Structures Quiz', subject: 'Data Structures', date: '18 Jan 2026', time: '11:00 AM', duration: '1 hour', status: 'Upcoming', score: null }, { id: 3, title: 'Web Development', subject: 'Web Development', date: '10 Jan 2026', time: '10:00 AM', duration: '2 hours', status: 'Completed', score: 85 }, ]; save() { if (this.editingId) { const i = this.exams.findIndex(e => e.id === this.editingId); if (i > -1) this.exams[i] = { ...this.formData, id: this.editingId }; } else { this.exams.push({ ...this.formData, id: Date.now() }); } this.resetForm(); } edit(e: any) { this.editingId = e.id; this.formData = { ...e }; delete (this.formData as any).id; this.showForm = true; } delete(e: any) { if (confirm('Delete?')) this.exams = this.exams.filter(x => x.id !== e.id); } resetForm() { this.formData = { title: '', subject: '', date: '', time: '', duration: '', status: 'Upcoming', score: null }; this.editingId = null; this.showForm = false; } }
